# Keep Your Child Safe

> Comprehensive resource hub providing free, evidence-based guidance on child safety, health, development, and family wellbeing for parents and educators.

Keep Your Child Safe is operated by the Global Children's Fund nonprofit organization and offers extensive educational materials, parenting guides, and safety resources covering physical protection, mental health, abuse prevention, and developmental milestones. The site serves parents, teachers, and caregivers seeking practical tools and knowledge to support children's safety and healthy development.

## Key Topics

- child safety
- child development
- parenting guidance
- abuse prevention
- bullying prevention
- child mental health
- family protection
- domestic violence resources
- substance abuse prevention
- child psychology
- behavior management
- educational materials
- emergency preparedness
- family wellbeing
- Kids' Academy

## Core Resources & Mission

- [Child Safety, Health & Wellfare](https://keepyourchildsafe.org): Homepage for KeepYourChildSafe.org with free resources on child safety, health, and development.
- [About Us - Keep Your Child Safe.org](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/about-us): About page for Keep Your Child Safe.org and Global Children's Fund nonprofit organization.
- [Books & Publications - Keep Your Child Safe.org](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/books-publications): Catalog of parenting books including step-parenting, behavior management, and sibling resources.
- [Free eBooks & online lessons for kids!](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/kids-academy): Free Kids' Academy with educational eBooks and lessons on safety, psychology, life skills.

## Child Safety & Protection

- [child safety information](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/child-safety): Child safety guide covering abduction prevention, risks, and emergency preparedness.
- [Child Abuse & Neglect](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/child-abuse): Resources on child abuse, neglect, maltreatment prevention, and intervention.
- [Bullying Information & Resources](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/bullying): Anti-bullying guide covering school bullying, cyberbullying, and intervention techniques.
- [Domestic Violence & Abuse - Keep Your Child Safe.org](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/domestic-violence): Domestic violence resources covering child safety, victim support, and abuse prevention.
- [Chemicals & Toxins - Keep Your Child Safe.org](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/toxic-chemicals): Chemical and toxin safety information covering environmental exposure and family protection.

## Child Development & Mental Health

- [Child Development Information](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/child-development): Child development guide covering milestones, growth, and developmental information for parents.
- [Child Mental Health - Keep Your Child Safe.org](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/child-mental-health): Child mental health resources covering therapy, disorders, and behavioral health support.
- [Children - Keep Your Child Safe.org](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/children): Guide to childhood issues including ADHD, behavioral problems, and psychology topics.
- [Health & Medical - Keep Your Child Safe.org](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/health-medical): Child health and medical safety information covering allergies, asthma, and wellness.

## Parenting Guidance & Family Support

- [Parenting Information & Resources](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/parenting): Comprehensive parenting guide covering styles, development, and practical parenting tools.
- [Life & Family Resources](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/life-family): Virtual guidebook for families addressing common life challenges and wellbeing issues.
- [Family Divorce & Children](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/divorce): Divorce guide for families covering custody, communication, and child adjustment support.
- [Drugs, Alcohol, and Addiction - Keep Your Child Safe.org](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/drugs-alcohol-and-addiction): Drug and alcohol prevention guide covering substance abuse and teen addiction awareness.

## Educational Materials & Teacher Resources

- [Activities & Printalbes for Kids](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/teacher-resources): Free teacher resources including printables for safety, anti-bullying, and character education.

## Get Involved

- [Help Us Help Kids - Keep Your Child Safe.org](https://keepyourchildsafe.org/help-kids): Fundraising and volunteer opportunities to support Keep Your Child Safe's mission.
